DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Physiologic Jaundice)

The 2-day duration of worsening jaundice in a thriving, term, exclusively breastfed infant without other risk factors is classic for breastfeeding jaundice; I will check the total and direct bilirubin levels to confirm. REQUEST TEST: Total_Bilirubin, Direct_Bilirubin
